scope: The #314 review notes: stop reasons checked against the pipeline set and never spliced into markup; requested assets matched by id and kind; the run-stopped banner on deep-dive pages.
method: Before every mutant the runner rewrites every subject from its committed bytes, checks its sha256 against the commit, and runs the unmutated test file, which must pass. It then replaces exactly one occurrence of `old` with `new` in `file`, runs the test file, and restores and re-checks the subject. Killed means the run exited non-zero with at least one failed test.

priorRun.finding: At that commit the two attribute insertions still used String.replace with a function replacement. Switching either back to a replacement string survived, because the stop-reason check already keeps `$` out of every reason. The insertions were then rebuilt as escaped attributes passed to the claim builder, so no replace call remains. Its mutants are not-generated-attributes-dropped, banner-attributes-dropped and claim-attributes-ignored.
